# Genc Krasniqi — Elite Personal Training in Dubai

> Premium in-home personal training, EMS training, virtual coaching, and football coaching in Dubai, UAE.

## About Genc Krasniqi

Genc Krasniqi is a former Swiss professional footballer (Grasshoppers Club Zürich, FC Rapperswil-Jona) and certified physiotherapist (Dipl. Physiotherapeut FH). He delivers bespoke fitness and health services directly to clients' homes across Dubai, specializing in high-net-worth individuals and expats.

## Services

- **Personal Training**: Bespoke in-home sessions combining workouts, physio, and sports massage — all in one visit. No gym required.
- **EMS Training**: Wireless EMS training powered by Visionbody — German-engineered, FDA-cleared. 98% muscle activation, 12 channels, 20 minutes. Guided by a certified pro.
- **Virtual Training**: Live 1-on-1 training over video (Zoom, FaceTime, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams) with real-time form correction and personal programming.
- **Football Coaching**: Professional football coaching by a former Swiss pro — tactics, speed, ball control, and game sharpening.
